$comment: A harbour for recordings of rafts and boats (docs/CANNONS.md; owner, 2026-11-18: "make a video of 2 rafts with cannons next to each other shooting at each other", "And one of a player driving a boat around"): a broad valley 160 m long down +z from (0, 0), its floor 48 m wide and 6 m under the land, closed at 140 m by a stone wall 6 blocks high, a still lake behind it one metre under the wall's top (5 m deep). Built on the flat world (?world=flat). The rafts and boats are added after (`d.scene('body', …)`); no events.
name: harbour
description: A broad still lake 5 m deep for rafts and boats.
